name: UK energy price cap
summary: Energy cap £1,723; final January forecasts point to the highest cap since January 2024
state: The Ofgem cap for October–December is £1,723 a year. Cornwall Insight has released its final January forecast, and reports say the cap will rise to its highest since January 2024; its earlier forecast was £1,999, up 16% (Cornwall Insight; Hargreaves Lansdown). Alert is held under hysteresis until Ofgem announces the January cap by 25 Nov.
for_you: Households on standard variable tariffs should expect higher bills from January; Ofgem and Citizens Advice list support schemes.
rubric_hit: Forecast rise ≥ 5%; Alert held pending Ofgem's 25 Nov announcement

sources.title: Cornwall Insight — Final January price cap forecast

why: The Ofgem cap sets bills for most UK households — a direct cost-of-living signal.
drivers: Wholesale gas and power prices, network costs, policy levies.

rubric.normal: Typical dual-fuel cap < £1,700/yr and next forecast change < +5%.
